verdict.rationale: Delaware's Division of Corporations runs online filing and tax portals that hold entity data, so AI-generated insights are a fair question for this kind of service. The evidence shows only PDF forms, deterministic fee and franchise-tax calculators, and status lookups, with no AI-generated insights or suggestions documented anywhere.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
